field.label: Type
field.help: Website rules use names (wildcards allowed). IP rules use one address or a network.

field.label: Website or IP address
field.help: Websites: example.com (the site and everything below it), *.example.com (the same), *example.com (any name ending in example.com), ad*.example.com. IP: 203.0.113.7 or 203.0.113.0/24.

field.label: What to do
field.help: Block stops access. Allow always lets it through, even when a block rule or a content-filter category would stop it.

field.label: Applies to devices
field.help: Leave empty for everyone, or enter device addresses or networks (for example 10.77.0.25 or 10.77.0.0/24). Allow rules for IP addresses always apply to everyone.
